title: Effective stats (test-only)
author: mewgenics-mods
description: Test-only overlay for the in-game harness's effective stats (the units event's effective block, `expect unit <stat>.effective`): LuckyRat, a Rat that gains LuckUp 3 on spawn (StatusOnSpawnIn), so its effective luck is base + 3. Load it next to fw-glow and _autoplay: `mods: _effective-stats, fw-glow, _autoplay`. Never for play.
